name: shape
description: Structural comparability gate — deterministically answers whether two CSV datasets can be compared. Deprecated aliases kept for one release: `shape --robot-triage` and `shape doctor --robot-triage` (both now emit the cmdrvl.doctor.v1 triage report) and `shape doctor health`.

usage: shape --robot-triage (deprecated alias of: shape doctor triage --json)

arguments.name: old
arguments.description: Old CSV file (required for compare mode)

arguments.name: new
arguments.description: New CSV file (required for compare mode)

options.name: delimiter
options.description: Force CSV delimiter for both files

options.name: no_witness
options.description: Suppress ambient witness ledger recording for this compare run

options.name: capsule_dir
options.description: Write deterministic repro capsule artifacts to this directory (default off)

options.name: profile
options.description: Scope checks to a profile file's include_columns

options.name: profile_id
options.description: Resolve a frozen profile from ~/.cmdrvl/config/profile/profiles; legacy ~/.epistemic/profiles is copied on first default use

options.name: lock
options.description: Verify both inputs against lock.v0 lockfile members (sha256/blake3 bytes_hash); refuses E_INPUT_NOT_LOCKED or E_INPUT_DRIFT

options.name: max_rows
options.description: Reserved in v0; row-limit refusal is deferred

options.name: max_bytes
options.description: Reserved in v0; byte-limit refusal is deferred

options.name: explicit
options.description: Show column names and other identifying metadata in output (default: column names redacted; free-text reasons, file paths and the --key column are not yet redacted, see bd-pitd)

options.name: schema
options.description: Print JSON Schema for shape.v0 output format and exit 0

options.name: describe
options.description: Print compiled operator.json and exit 0 without positional args

options.name: robot_triage
options.description: Deprecated alias of `shape doctor triage --json`: emits the cmdrvl.doctor.v1 triage report without positional args

commands.name: capabilities
commands.description: Top-level machine-readable capability contract for headless agents (this document)

commands.name: robot-docs
commands.description: Top-level paste-ready operating notes for agents

ledger_path_resolution: legacy ~/.epistemic/witness.jsonl is copied on first default use

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Read-only diagnostics emitting cmdrvl.doctor.v1: `doctor [--json]` (health), `doctor capabilities --json` (embeds this contract), `doctor triage --json` (next_actions). Exit 0 healthy, 1 unhealthy, 2 usage error. Deprecated aliases: `doctor health [--json]`, `doctor --robot-triage`.

2.meaning: REFUSAL / CLI error / witness internal error

refusals.message: Unsupported encoding (UTF-16/32 BOM or NUL bytes)
One or both files are empty
Input file not present in provided lockfiles
Input file hash does not match locked member
Input exceeds row or byte limit

env_vars.name: EPISTEMIC_WITNESS
env_vars.description: Overrides the witness ledger path for compare runs; doctor commands do not write it.

env_vars.name: HOME
env_vars.description: Used to resolve ~/.cmdrvl default state and config paths; doctor commands do not write them.

env_vars.name: NO_COLOR
env_vars.description: Any non-empty value disables ANSI styling in clap help and error output.

env_vars.name: TERM
env_vars.description: TERM=dumb disables ANSI styling; output is also unstyled whenever stdout/stderr is not a TTY.

env_vars.name: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH
env_vars.description: Unix seconds used instead of the wall clock for the witness record timestamp (reproducible builds convention).

side_effects.notes: Compare runs append one witness record unless --no-witness; --capsule-dir writes repro artifacts only when given. capabilities, robot-docs and doctor are read-only.

robot_triage.output: deprecated alias of shape doctor triage --json

fix_mode.behavior: exits 2, emits only stderr, and names read-only alternatives

accepts.description: Two CSV datasets that may be compared after schema, key, granularity, and type checks.

agent_rules: Run shape before rvl whenever the task is to compare two tabular datasets.
Do not run rvl on the pair when shape reports REFUSAL or INCOMPATIBLE.
Use the same key/profile choices for shape and the downstream rvl run.
